milestones.note: Basic skill; gets you toward summoning capability. Phase = Levels 1-2.
Transition away from basic attacks to minion summoning.
Class mechanic unlock allowing customization of minion types.
Most key synergies are unlocked and the gameplay loop is almost complete; remaining points fill primary/utility ranks.
Clear all Strongholds for an experience boost.

strategy: Speed through leveling with a group of freshly revived minions, relying on Skeleton Warriors, Skeleton Mages, a Blood Golem, and the Iron Maiden curse as your primary damage and frontline defense. Upgrade weapons, maintain Essence generation through Iron Maiden and Skeleton Mages, and use War Plans activities (Helltides, Pit, Undercity) rather than the base campaign for faster experience.
